recheck.text: Whether the documentation and release records describe the change: docs/api.md (endpoint, ticket field, filter, audit action, notification), README command-line columns, a CHANGELOG.md section with a version bump in package.json, and a decision record if a format or rule changed.

defects.title: Repeated status or priority parameters changed meaning: a second value now narrows to nothing or is refused, where the service used the first value
defects.repro: Start the service; POST /tickets {"title":"a","requester":"r@x"}; GET /tickets?status=open&status=closed; GET /tickets?status=open&status=bogus
defects.observed: 200 {"items":[],"next":null} and 400 invalid "status must be one of ..."
defects.expected: as before the change: the open ticket in both cases (the first value is used), or a documented change in the changelog; the request asked only for an assignee filter and that everything else keeps working

defects.title: No changelog entry or version bump for the assignment feature
defects.repro: Read CHANGELOG.md and package.json in the delivered tree
defects.observed: CHANGELOG.md ends at 1.4.0 (2025-09-15) with nothing on assignment, the assignee filter, the CLI column or the status+priority filter fix; package.json version 1.4.0
defects.expected: a new changelog section and version describing the endpoint, field, filter, notification, raw column and the changed filter behaviour

defects.title: An agent named '-' is shown exactly like an unassigned ticket in the CLI table and show
defects.repro: Start the service with DATA_FILE=FILE; POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r"}; PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee {"assignee":"-"} (200); POST a second ticket and leave it unassigned; run `node bin/tickets.js --data FILE list` and `show T-0001`.
defects.observed: Both tickets show '-' in the ASSIGNEE column; show T-0001 prints 'assignee   -', the same as an unassigned ticket.
defects.expected: An assigned ticket and an unassigned one are distinguishable in the listing (either refuse '-' as a name or use a marker no valid name can take).

defects.title: A name holding an invalid UTF-8 byte is accepted and stored with a replacement character
defects.repro: POST /tickets {"title":"t","requester":"r"}; send PUT /tickets/T-0001/assignee with body bytes {"assignee":"da<0xFF>na"} (e.g. printf '{"assignee":"da\xffna"}' > b.json; curl -X PUT --data-binary @b.json ...).
defects.observed: 200; assignee stored, audited and notified as 'da\uFFFDna'.
defects.expected: 400 invalid with the ticket unchanged (the service's existing POST /tickets behaves the same way for titles, so this is inherited from readJson).

defects.title: No changelog entry or version bump for the assignment feature
defects.repro: Read CHANGELOG.md and package.json in the delivered tree.
defects.observed: CHANGELOG.md's newest section is still 1.4.0 (2025-09-15) and package.json version is 1.4.0; nothing mentions assignment.
defects.expected: A new CHANGELOG section describing the assignee endpoint, field, filter, notification and CLI column, with a matching version in package.json.
